scope: Controlled dependency updates for warning governance and reproducible CI/runtime behavior

when_to_upgrade: documented external warning becomes reproducible and noisy in current CI/smoke
upstream fix or safer supported version is known
change can be isolated from business refactor and release hardening work
when_not_to_upgrade: warning is project-origin and should be fixed in our code
warning is already neutralized by a compatibility shim without behavior drift
upgrade risk is higher than operational value or affects public contracts
notes: Dependency changes should update dependency_warning_inventory_v1.json and python_environment.json evidence together.
Any accepted dependency warning budget must stay explicit in warning_governance_v1.json.

tracked_packages.name: pytest
tracked_packages.impact: warning summary format and CI behavior

tracked_packages.name: ddtrace
tracked_packages.impact: external plugin/import warnings in some environments
